findings.title: Validator work is assigned after gates that require it
findings.failure_scenario: RG-1 must prove source-anchor-valid P0/P1 evidence, but Book 08 assigns anchor, quote, and proof validation to RG-2, which cannot start before RG-1 exits.
findings.safeguard_gap: The generic recovery validator cannot decide phase ownership, and the phase-validator test is assigned to RG-5.
findings.owner: Book 08 phase owner with Books 04/96 validator owners
findings.closure: Place the minimum evidence validator and phase-sequence validator before the gates that consume them.

findings.title: Advisory compatibility has contradictory verdict and residual semantics
findings.failure_scenario: The same advisory-mode missing or empty sidecar can become Unknown/OK with no residual under Book 04 or retain legacy Needs Fix routing under Book 06.
findings.safeguard_gap: No authoritative mode-by-condition matrix resolves the owner-book conflict.
findings.owner: Book 06 compatibility owner with Book 04 residual owner
findings.closure: Define one complete compatibility matrix and keep empty-residual suppression invariant.

findings.title: Source coverage claims miss a declared Chapter 6 architecture profile
findings.failure_scenario: A Chapter 6 architecture finding cannot be represented without schema failure or misclassification, while broad coverage assertions still pass.
findings.safeguard_gap: The enum lacks architecture and Books 98/99 have no stable source-section registry.
findings.owner: Book 02 schema owner with Books 01/04/98/99 owners
findings.closure: Add or normatively map the architecture domain and cover every normative source section by stable ID.

findings.title: No historical Whole-directory finding ledger existed
findings.failure_scenario: Later reviews cannot distinguish Open, Closed, or Superseded findings or verify closure evidence.
findings.safeguard_gap: Immutable log placement is specified without a canonical historical ledger path or link.
findings.recheck: After Book 96 links a canonical ledger with stable statuses and closure evidence.

findings.title: All 33 RGR rows have owners but none has an explicit acceptance reference
findings.failure_scenario: The validator can confirm non-empty test prose but cannot prove which owner-book acceptance criterion closes a requirement.
findings.safeguard_gap: Book 99 covers IDs by owner only; free-text test intent is not an acceptance anchor.
findings.recheck: After all 33 rows contain an explicit acceptance section anchor or acceptance ID.
